programme.title: Sobharaj
programme.desc: When Sobhraj, the notorious leader of the underworld syndicate, is killed by the police in an encounter, a lookalike of him is recruited to work as an undercover spy to eliminate the gang.

programme.title: Pulliman
programme.desc: Kunjunni, an orphan, and Radha, who makes a living by selling statues of deities, love each other. However, problems arise when her father opposes their relationship.

programme.title: Mahanagaram
programme.desc: Viswan, a smuggler, keeps his identity hidden from the new commissioner in town, Chandradas. However, once Chandradas uncovers Viswan's true identity, he starts to track him down.

programme.title: Appu
programme.desc: Appukuttan falls in love with Sarojini, who does not reciprocate his feelings. Things take a dramatic turn when Sarojini is found murdered and Appukuttan is implicated in the crime.

programme.title: Sopanam
programme.desc: Looking at Anantha's passion for music, a famous singer decides to teach him. However, their relationship turns sour when Anantha falls in love with the singer's daughter.

programme.title: 7th Day
programme.desc: When two friends run into David, an IPS official, they reveal an unfortunate event that changed their lives. David helps them get out of the mess, but he is not what he claims to be.

programme.title: Kanchanam
programme.desc: Anu leads an unhappy life as her parents are on the verge of divorce. However, Anu's life takes a turn for the better when James enters her life and they become friends.

programme.title: Vellathooval
programme.desc: Jiya, a fun-loving girl, is tired of her conservative family and therefore decides to abscond with her friend Manu. They become good friends, but society misunderstands them.

programme.title: Pradesika Varthakal
programme.desc: Krishnan and Kochappy, two thieves, return to their village after becoming rich. However, they hatch a plan to create chaos and steal again.

programme.title: Unnikrishnante Adyathe Christmas
programme.desc: Sophia has an argument with her parents over her marriage and leaves the house. Her parents seek the help of her close friend, Unnikrishnan, in getting her back in the house.

programme.title: Pigman
programme.desc: After his thesis gets rejected and he gets expelled from his college, the idealistic Sreekumar is left with no choice but to take up menial jobs in a pigsty.

programme.title: Indrajith
programme.desc: Bhasi follows in his father, Bhaskaran's footsteps and becomes a local goon. He has to deal with Achan Kunju, who plans to get back at Bhaskaran for humiliating his father years ago.

programme.title: Ottayal Pattalam
programme.desc: Trouble ensues after Venu, a taxi driver, gets suspected of abducting Gopika Varma, an NRI. While he tries to clear his name, Venu and Gopika fall for each other.

programme.title: Vinayapoorvam Vidyadharan
programme.desc: Vidyadharan is a simple bank employee, but his meagre earnings are insufficient for his wife's extravagant lifestyle. Eventually, she costs him his job, forcing him to struggle.

programme.title: Kudumbasametham
programme.desc: Raghavan hates singers as he had witnessed a terrible life being a son of a classical singer. Sivan, Raghavan's son, faces many challenges when he shows his interest towards music.

programme.title: Parvathy Parinayam
programme.desc: Parvathy, a young woman, falls in love with Sivankutty, a lineman, but her mother disapproves of her relationship. Shortly after, her father returns after 18 years and fixes her marriage to an engineer.

programme.title: Arhatha
programme.desc: Devaraj takes a job at the same factory where his father, retired Captain Ramakrishnan, is killed mysteriously while he is on duty. After he starts working, he must face many challenges.

programme.title: Uppukandam Brothers
programme.desc: Ananthan Pilla murders Chacko for being an informer of his illicit business. When the police refuse to file a complaint, Chacko's son approaches a prominent family known as the Uppukandam Brothers.

programme.title: Bhoomi
programme.desc: Bhoominathan, a NASA scientist, returns to his village in Tamil Nadu only to discover that it is suffering from a severe drought. He decides to fight against the evil corporations responsible for his people's plight.

programme.title: Pilots
programme.desc: A pilot, who is falsely accused of murder, finds his deceased friend's sister masquerading as a nun. To clear his name, he must convince her to reveal the truth and testify on his behalf.

programme.title: Kottaram Veettile Apputtan
programme.desc: Apputtan, a rich man, gives Ambili, a young woman, the financial help she needs to become a doctor. However, he soon finds himself falling in love with her.

programme.title: Agnidevan
programme.desc: Two brothers are constantly at odds over continuing their family legacy. Eventually, their rivalry reaches extreme proportions, threatening to destroy the bond of brotherhood.

programme.title: Kinnari Puzhayoram
programme.desc: A father chooses the richer of two brothers as a suitor for his daughter. Filled with anger, the spurned brother acts like a holy man, which changes all their lives unexpectedly.

programme.title: Bandhukkal Sathrukkal
programme.desc: Two brothers, both moneylenders, hate each other and extend their mutual hatred to their families as well. However, they face several obstacles that intensify after their estrangement.

programme.title: Koodevide
programme.desc: When her father's business suffers tremendous losses, Soorya, a determined girl, decides to step up to support her family.

programme.title: Hariharan Pillai Happy Aanu
programme.desc: Hariharan, a builder, constructs a house for a wealthy man, who does not pay him. However, chaos ensues when he falls in love with the man's daughter.

programme.title: Chamayam
programme.desc: Rival fishermen Esthappan and Anto set aside differences when their shared passion for theatre opens doors to experiences beyond their everyday lives.

programme.title: Maniyarayile Ashokan
programme.desc: Ashokan desperately wishes to get married as he is past the marriageable age. However, bad luck and a series of unfortunate circumstances threaten to make this a distant dream.

programme.title: Finger Print
programme.desc: A patriarch of a royal family goes on a mission to find the murderers responsible for killing his descendant. He takes the help of his nephews who are police officers.

programme.title: Jubilee
programme.desc: Joji, a motorcycle enthusiast, is the youngest son of a well-known man named Kora Sahib. When Joji is falsely accused of murder, he tries to prove his innocence with the support of his father.

programme.title: Saamoohyapaadam
programme.desc: Vishnu gets acquainted with Raghu during a trip and learns that he is rich and is returning home after 16 years. Then, Vishnu pushes Raghu into a ravine and goes to his house pretending to be him.

programme.title: Pakal Nakshatrangal
programme.desc: A filmmaker is found dead under mysterious circumstances. Years later, his son, Adi, a successful writer, digs into his past and tries to demystify the reason for his father's death.

programme.title: Europe Malayalee Journal
programme.desc: A portrayal of the lives of expatriates from Kerala who are now settled in Europe and have to face numerous challenges in their fight for survival.

programme.title: 48th Soorya Festival 2025
programme.desc: Distinguished artists and musicians present enchanting performances interpreting the rich culture of India during the 2025 edition of the Soorya Festival.

programme.title: Samsaram Aaroghyathinu Haniharam
programme.desc: The people of the Panimalai hill station are in trouble as the government puts a ban on speaking to control the spread of the 'dumb-flu' that spreads only through talking.

programme.title: Mayaponman
programme.desc: Prasanth is a mechanic and is best friends with Freddy. One day, they come across a girl, whose extended family is chasing her for her inherited wealth, and try to save her.

programme.title: Varsham
programme.desc: Venu, the owner of a small-scale finance firm, loses his son in an unfortunate incident. He gets involved in a lot of social work that soon leads him to become an obstacle in the way of his rivals.

programme.title: Njan Salperu Ramankutty
programme.desc: Ramankutty, a respected school-teacher, agrees to marry one of his uncle's daughters. However, he changes his mind after meeting another cousin, making his life difficult in society.

programme.title: Oru Minnaminunginte Nurungu Vettam
programme.desc: The lives of a childless and elderly couple take a drastic turn when the young daughter of a family friend comes to live with them.

programme.title: Palayam
programme.desc: Noble, a lorry driver, claims that he is the son of a judge. However, after learning about him, his stepbrother plans to murder him to amass his mother's wealth.

programme.title: Beware of Dogs
programme.desc: Four troublemaking friends constantly annoy their landlord in a rented house. Forced to leave, they escape to Pondicherry, where new adventures await.

programme.title: Jeevan Masai
programme.desc: In a village, an Ayurvedic doctor is famous for predicting people's death by feeling the pulse of the patient. However, the villagers realise the truth when an allopathic doctor reveals the secret.

programme.title: Duplicate
programme.desc: Manu, a criminal, finds his doppelgänger in a budding chef, Bablu, and uses this fact to his advantage. Later, Manu tries to kill the chef so that he can take over his life and escape the law.

programme.title: Paribhavam Parvathi
programme.desc: A young couple, Mukundan and Parvathi, along with their little daughter deals with various day-to-day problems in a comical way.

programme.title: Changathipoocha
programme.desc: Brothers Sreedharan and Raman are embroiled in a bitter feud over their ancestral property. In a bid to consolidate all the wealth, Raman hires Sivankutty to woo Sreedharan's daughter.

programme.title: 48th Soorya Festival 2025
programme.desc: Distinguished artists and musicians present enchanting performances interpreting the rich culture of India during the 2025 edition of the Soorya Festival.

programme.title: Iyer the Great
programme.desc: After surviving an accident, Soorya Narayana Iyer gains the power of clairvoyance and starts to foresee devastating incidents. He manages to impede the plans of the terrorists and a ruthless businessman, who vows to destroy his new enemy.

programme.title: Njangal Santhushtaranu
programme.desc: Sajeev, a police officer, who lives with his father and two sisters, falls in love with a police commissioner's daughter and gets married to her. Soon the girl starts creating problems in their life.

programme.title: Geethanjali
programme.desc: After the death of one of the twins, a family experiences strange incidents that probe them to seek advice from a quirky psychologist who reveals secrets that leave everyone shocked.

programme.title: I.G.
programme.desc: Inspector General Durga Prasad gets appointed as the head of an anti-terrorism squad. However, a revelation soon forces him to choose between his family and his duty.

programme.title: Prabhatha Sandhya
programme.desc: Usha, a foreign-returned woman, falls in love with Balan, a poor school teacher. However, her family opposes their union and wants her to marry her cousin Thampi.

programme.title: Mattoral
programme.desc: Susheela deserts her children and husband, Kaimal, to begin a new life with Giri. On learning this, Kaimal's friend, Balan, tries to reconcile them.

programme.title: Out of Syllabus
programme.desc: When village boy Gopikrishnan goes to study in a city college, he is bullied by his classmates. Namitha supports him through his difficult phase and they develop a close bond.

programme.title: Kinnari Puzhayoram
programme.desc: A father chooses the richer of two brothers as a suitor for his daughter. Filled with anger, the spurned brother acts like a holy man, which changes all their lives unexpectedly.

programme.title: Bandhukkal Sathrukkal
programme.desc: Two brothers, both moneylenders, hate each other and extend their mutual hatred to their families as well. However, they face several obstacles that intensify after their estrangement.

programme.title: Koodevide?
programme.desc: Alice, a young teacher, is in love with Captain Thomas. However, Thomas suspects that Alice is having an illicit affair with Ravi, one of her students.

programme.title: Hariharan Pillai Happy Aanu
programme.desc: Hariharan, a builder, constructs a house for a wealthy man, who does not pay him. However, chaos ensues when he falls in love with the man's daughter.

programme.title: Chamayam
programme.desc: Rival fishermen Esthappan and Anto set aside differences when their shared passion for theatre opens doors to experiences beyond their everyday lives.

programme.title: Maniyarayile Ashokan
programme.desc: Ashokan desperately wishes to get married as he is past the marriageable age. However, bad luck and a series of unfortunate circumstances threaten to make this a distant dream.

programme.title: Finger Print
programme.desc: A patriarch of a royal family goes on a mission to find the murderers responsible for killing his descendant. He takes the help of his nephews who are police officers.

programme.title: Parking
programme.desc: A parking spot frays the relationship between two neighbours of different generations and world views. Soon, the two men find themselves in an escalating battle to have the space all to themselves.

programme.title: Kho-Kho
programme.desc: A physical education teacher named Maria decides to train the girls' school team in the sport of kho-kho and make her long-lost dream come true.

programme.title: Govindankutty Thirakkilanu
programme.desc: Govindankutty faces several obstacles after he inherits an ancestral property which often results in hilarious situations.

programme.title: Boyy Friennd
programme.desc: Ramesh's mother files a case against the home minister for molesting her. After a few days, the minister is found dead and people suspect Ramesh of murdering him.

programme.title: Excuse Me Ethu Collegila
programme.desc: Two friends, Ananthan and Appukuttan, set out to make a name for themselves. After losing their jobs, they venture into the real estate business and meet a girl who changes their lives.

programme.title: Iyer the Great
programme.desc: After surviving an accident, Soorya Narayana Iyer gains the power of clairvoyance and starts to foresee devastating incidents. He manages to impede the plans of the terrorists and a ruthless businessman, who vows to destroy his new enemy.

programme.title: Onnaman
programme.desc: Ravishankar, a street urchin, is looked after by Salim, a local don. After Salim's demise, Ravishankar rises to power and fights against an evil gangster.

programme.title: Thazhvaram
programme.desc: Balan and Raju's friendly relationship turns hostile when Raju murders Balan's wife and steals his hard-earned money. Thereafter, Balan decides to take revenge on Raju.

programme.title: Mark
programme.desc: When 18 children are abducted and found dead, Mark, a police officer, races to catch the criminals. With only 18 hours left, he must confront powerful foes and use unconventional tactics to succeed.

programme.title: Kali
programme.desc: Siddharth often has problems with his wife Anjali owing to his short temper. Things take an unexpected turn when they get involved with a gangster.

programme.title: Pakal Nakshatrangal
programme.desc: A filmmaker is found dead under mysterious circumstances. Years later, his son, Adi, a successful writer, digs into his past and tries to demystify the reason for his father's death.

programme.title: Winter
programme.desc: Fed up with the fast-paced city life, Ramdas and his wife decide to move to a quiet bungalow on the outskirts of the city. However, some strange happenings in the surrounding put their lives at risk.

programme.title: Female Unnikrishnan
programme.desc: Unni, who has a feminine voice, gets insulted by everyone in his neighbourhood. His life takes a turn when he gets married to a rich girl who is speech-impaired.

programme.title: Chakkikotha Chankaran
programme.desc: Pradeep marries Roshni without his family's consent. However, Roshni decides to move to her friend Shailaja's house with Pradeep, unaware that she is Pradeep's sister-in-law.

programme.title: Grama Panchayath
programme.desc: A young man tries to break away from his poverty-ridden life as a barber's son and hopes to study further. His father, however, refuses to send him away and threatens to commit suicide.

programme.title: Mayamayooram
programme.desc: Maheshwar struggles to raise Malu, his 5-year-old daughter, who holds him responsible for her mother's passing. Ganga attempts to mend the rift between them.

programme.title: Anubandham
programme.desc: The life of Sunandha, a poor widow, turns around after she starts a kindergarten with the help of her silent admirer. But things become complicated because of a tragic event.

programme.title: Jambulingam
programme.desc: Hardworking villager Jambulingam decides to fight against the oppressive landlord who exploits the local people. He stands against the barbarities and atrocities inflicted upon the villagers.

programme.title: Sankaranum Mohananum
programme.desc: Mohanakrishnan is a fashion photographer and his brother's ghost haunts him. He had died after being bitten by a snake, leaving behind a young wife.

programme.title: Pigman
programme.desc: After his thesis gets rejected and he gets expelled from his college, the idealistic Sreekumar is left with no choice but to take up menial jobs in a pigsty.

programme.title: Banking Hours 10 to 4
programme.desc: Three young men plot to rob a busy bank during its working hours. However, their plans go haywire after someone gets murdered in the bank premises, and they are accused of the crime.

programme.title: Nagaram
programme.desc: When Kochi's waste crisis spirals out of control, a group of crooked politicians scheme to dump the garbage in a village.

programme.title: Butterflies
programme.desc: Two friends, Prince and Sadasivan, agree to kidnap a girl for their friend, Pavithran. However, they find themselves in trouble when they abduct the wrong woman who then refuses to leave their house.

programme.title: Gulumaal: The Escape
programme.desc: Jerry Matthews, a con man, breaks away from his family. One day, he meets an ex-convict with whom he plans a daunting heist.

programme.title: Panchagni
programme.desc: Indira's life turns upside down after she gets a life sentence for murdering Avarachan, a landlord, who killed a young tribal woman after raping her.

programme.title: Nakshathra Tharattu
programme.desc: Sunil falls head over heels in love with Hema and marries her. However, things take a turn when they both discover that they are orphans.

programme.title: Simhasanam
programme.desc: Madhava Menon, a village chief who is highly respected for his integrity, faces trouble when a rival clan wreaks havoc in his village. Soon, his son decides to restore order.
